Firozabad SP Measures Tazia Height, Orders Reduction for Muharram Procession

In Firozabad, Superintendent of Police (SP) Anuj Chaudhary reportedly measured the height of tazias, traditional replicas carried during Muharram processions. He ordered the reduction of tazias exceeding 10 feet in height. This action was taken in preparation for the Muharram procession, with reports indicating that tazias over the specified height would not be permitted.
